chapter.verse: Keima hong phat Pasian aw, dai dide in om kei in!
Bang hang hiam cih leh migilote leh zuauthu gente keima langah hong pang uh a, keimah hong gensia-in, zuauthu bekbek genin nei uh hi.
Amaute in muhdahna kamte pau-in kei hong gensia uh a, thu om lopi-in kei hong langpan’ uh hi.
Amaute ka itna, amau adinga thu ka ngetsakna nangawn, amaute in hong thukna-in kei hong mawhsak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in hoihna’ adingin siatna, itna’ adingin muhdahna tawh kei hong thuk uh hi.
Ama langah migilo khat pangsak in la, thusitna thuak dingin mawhna zong mipa khat paipihsak in.
Amah thu a kisit ciangin, thu lelin pusuak sak in la, ama thungetnate zong mawhna suak sak in.
Amah a khan’ tom hen la, midang khat in ama nasep za ngah ta hen!
Ama tate, pa nei lo hi ta hen la, a zi pen meigong numei hi ta hen!
Ama tate vak kawikawi-in khut dawhin ngen hen la, a kisiasa amau’ teen’na mun panin kihawlkhia ta hen!
Ama leibatna-pa in a neih khempeuh man hen la, khualmite in a om lai sunsunte sut ta hen.
Ama tungah migitna kuamah in lak kei hen la, pa nei lo ama tate, kuamah in hehpih kei ta hen!
Ama suan-le-khakte bei hen la, khang khat sungin ama min maimang ta hen!
Topa ’ mai-ah a pu a pate’ mawhna kiciamteh hen la, a nu’ mawhna kimaisak kei ta hen!
Topa ’ mai-ah tua mawhnate om-omsak in la, leitung panin amah a kiphawkna bei ta hen!
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in migitna lah ding ngaihsun lo a, a zawng a cimawhte leh lungsim kitamzan mite a sih dongun bawlsia hi.
Amah in mi samsiat nuamsa hi; ama tungah samsiatnate tungsak in! Amah in thupha pia nuam lo hi; kuamah in amah thupha pia kei ta hen!
amah in puan bangin samsiatna silh hi; tua pen ama pumpi sungah tui bangin, a guhte sungah sathau bangin lutin kizel ta hen!
Tua pen, amah a kituamna puan tawh kibang hen la, ni sim-a amah a kigakna kawnggak tawh kibang ta hen!
Hih pen, keimah hong mawhsakte’ tung, kei hong gensiate’ tungah, Topa ’ kiang pan-a thaman hi ta hen!
Ahih hangin Pasian ka Topa aw, na min na ngaihsutna tawh keima taangin hong pang in la, na itna kip hoih ahih manin kei hong honkhia in!
Bang hang hiam cih leh kei genthei-in ka cimawh a, ka lungsim tawng dongin hong nasak hi.
Nitak lam-a niliim bangin kei ka bei a, kauphe bangin kei hong kisingkhia hi.
An ngolhna hangin ka khukte zaw a, ka pumpi sa zong kiam khin ta hi.
Kei, amaute’ nuihsatin ka om a, amaute in kei hong muh ciangun hong lupeisan uh hi.
Topa ka Pasian aw, kei hong huh in! Nangma itna kip tawh kituakin kei hong hon in!
Topa aw, hih pen nangma bawl, nangma khut in a sep ahihna amaute thei sak in!
Amaute in kei hong samsiatsiat hen, ahih hangin nangmah in kei thupha nong pia ding hi. Ka langte zahhuaisak in la, na nasempa keimah hong kipaksak ta in!
Kei hong mawhsakte in mindaina silh uh hen la, puanza silh bangin amau’ maizumna tawh kituamcip ta uh hen!
Topa tungah ka kam tawh lungdamna nakpi takin ka ko ding a, mihonte lakah amah ka phat ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna daan a piapa’ khutsung panin a hon dingin mi cimawhpa’ taklam-ah amah hong ding hi.
